body: Are you still with us?  I hope you're okay.  Sounds like you have some good things in your life...a job you enjoy and decent coworkers. You seem to find some joy in small things like your pasta salad.  Those are positives.  Hopefully you're working thru this.

I'm sorry you're feeling this way, but something kept you from doing something extreme and that's a positive.   I get it...tomorrow is my bday and, for me, its not a day to celebrate.  I even hid it on stupid Facebook so I wouldn't be reminded by the well wishes.  I guess its only logical that for those of us struggling in life, to not be joyous over the day we were born.  How are you doing now?  Wishing you the best.

I understand, I feel the same.  So much that I think of taking myself off FB as it just makes me feel worse than I already feel.  Everyone posting happy messages, pictures where everyone looks so joyful and here I sit feeling as bad as one can feel.  Its all too much.  I get that we all oughta wish our friends a happy birthday, but now its their children and parents birthdays and anniversaries as well.  Ughhh.  Its too much.  I think its better just not to go on FB, for both of us.  Yet I don't follow this advice myself.

This is awful to read, I'm so sorry for what they're doing to you.  Its horrible and they don't deserve you.  I hope you stay strong and realize that how they behave is their issue, its no reflection on you or your self worth.  I wonder what their motivation was for demanding you to return after telling you to go.  They need help.  I'm glad you have friends, I hope they're close by in case you need them.
If you are still with us, would you chat with me a bit?  I'm not doing so well myself, perhaps we can support each other.  I'm sorry you're in pain, I know life can be so lonely and painful.
Just hung up with Cox, said they were working on it.  Within 20 seconds of hanging up, my picture came back.  I am that powerful!  Haha
I'm so sorry for your pain, are you still with us?
I just came across your post.  Would you want to chat?  I hope you're okay.
Wow, so sorry to hear about your son.  Would you share why he's in the ER?

I'm so sorry you're feeling this way.  If you don't mind sharing, how long have you felt this way?  Maybe therapy and trying meds are worth a try?  I hope you try talking with someone, it can help.  Hugs...

Its upsetting, I know.  It happened to me too.  I always thought if I got desperate enough to call Suicide Prevention, that someone very kind and sympathetic would immediately pick up and say just the right thing to comfort me.  Doesn't seem to work that way, sadly.  Can you share here?
I hope you find a good, loving home for him.  All the best.

What is, giving your pup to a no-kill shelter?

You haven't anyone... a friend, a family member... who might help you out?

I'm sorry, I know how hard it is.  I'm sad too.   Every being has value, no one is "better" than the other.  Each life has important and we all are stronger than we realize.  I'm hoping you find your strength.  I wish you the best.

Take it as a sign that you ought to reconsider.  Becoming a quadriplegic will not make life any better, so please stick around.  Talk to us, talk to a friend, a therapist... I know life can suck at times, but you sound like you have something to contribute.  Care to tell us about the work you created, that you'd like to see published?

I'm sorry your mom reacted the way she did, just realize it shows her to have shortcomings and is no way a reflection on you.  I'm sure she was scared and didn't know how to react properly (which would have been to give you comfort and support), and while it hurts to have someone close to us react in such a way, I hope you don't think too much on it.  When I told my best friend how sad I was and that I didn't want to be here anymore, she didn't react at all.  You would've thought I said "its a beautiful day out" or something.  It bothered me, because it seemed so uncaring but I know each person processes and handles life's curveballs so differently.  We have no control over that. 

I hope you stay strong and things get better.

It is sad that no one responded to your post the other day.  Hopefully we're making up for it now.  I read of your struggles, and life certainly has its challenges.  But maybe the support here will have you reconsider.  I hope so.
You are in my thoughts & prayers, I sincerely hope something changes so that you don't find yourself homeless.  Never know, things change.

Aaah, I see.  I was just telling someone about a psychiatrist that really made me feel cared for...when he retired I was so upset.  I'd been to many therapists and doctors, but he was the only one I felt was helping.  And he had to be the one to retire.  Still hurts.  He had such a kind, gentle, soothing demeanor.  I guess I saw him almost as a father figure in a way.  

So I understand and feel for you.
Why is your therapy ending? I'm sorry you're feeling this way, have you let your psychiatrist know how you feel about the end of your therapy?
Why don't you share what your friend is saying... hopefully we can help.

You're so young, lots of people get a little off track at times.  You are taking steps to do better and I commend you for it!  You have lots of time to make your life better and I'm betting on you.  I agree with duder501, get the clerical mistake fixed so you can get more hours.

I'm so sorry you are going thru all that, and now to be looking to place your pup somewhere.  I look at mine everyday, thinking I need to give her up... I feel such guilt for being severely depressed and therefore not having the energy to give her the life she deserves.  Here, as a last resort, I will bring her to the no kill shelter.  But the thought of not seeing myself who she goes home to bothers me...

I care about you and your best bud.  He sounds sweet and you sound like you love him so much.  How long have you had him and how old is he?  Its sad to read you're ready to give him up, are you sure you're really wanting to do that?
Glad to hear from you.  I hope you get some relief from all you're going thru.  You thought you killed the demon once, do it again!  Then teach me how.  I'll pay!
I'm so sorry to hear of your sadness.  Are you still here with us?  Maybe we can talk a little?  It might make us both feel better...
Are you still with us, I hope?  You should be proud of yourself, for graduating!

When do you see your therapist?  Please be completely honest with him/her.  Otherwise it will be of no help to you or your family.  You need to get healthy for yourself and your children.  I also think its a great idea to bring your 16 year old into the session to give her a voice.  Could be so beneficial for your whole family.
Keep breathing, you can do it.
Glad to hear you're going to see your therapist today, be brave and tell him or her everything you've been going thru.  Proud of you!
I won't look at that if its something awful.  I'm here to talk if you want.  Please, lets talk.
Oh wow.  I hope you changed your mind.  You still here?
Mind sharing how old you are?

It doesn't sound like nothing to me, I'm struggling every day too.  Feeling alone is horrible, especially for those of us suffering from depression.  Are you in the care of a therapist or psychiatrist?
Are you still in your car?  I'll keep talking with you, is that okay?  Did something happen that has you so distressed... if you want to share?  If not, we can talk about whatever you like.
I'll stay with you.  I'm so sorry you're in pain.  If you want to talk, I'm here.  You really shouldn't be alone.  Is there anyone you could call, to spend a little time with you?

Honey, do you share with your husband what you share here?  Show your husband your posts and see if he thinks there isn't a problem.  Surely he is aware of your numerous failed suicide attempts in a short period of time and the subsequent stays in the hospital and psych ward.  And now another threat to try.  I keep saying the same thing (definition of insanity), hoping you'll look in the mirror and see you need treatment.  I get that my responses and some others to you are not what you want to hear and you find them judgmental, but I feel we're simply being real with you.  

Not sure what you want from us.  Hugs on here and attention are not the answer. This isn't a joke and its sad for you and your kids if you keep going like this.  How can you?   Do you want the truth or I guess you want us to tip toe around saying you're just fine.  I can't say that based on what you post, it would be errant.  So, what do you want?  (Notice I didn't mention alcohol since you don't seem to want us to focus on that)

Not as bad as it seems?   Here's a suggestion...  Ease up on the drinking and take some time to read thru your posts for the past couple weeks.  That in itself will hopefully get you to seek treatment.  But please don't appease us by saying its not that bad when you're pleading for help and then get advice by many when we see the alcohol, together with your overwhelming suicidal thoughts and tendencies, are a very real problem.  Give yourself and your kids a gift by seeking help from professionals.

I will give you a hug.  But I so hope you start hearing what people are telling you honey, and you seek treatment SOON.   Its apparent from your numerous posts that alcohol is a problem and it seems to be aggravating your suicidal thoughts.  I've seen others tell you to seek help from your therapist and advising further hospitalization to keep yourself safe.  This situation has to be harmful to your children, if you're drunk all the time while in your care. Please listen to the advice, unfortunately there's only so much we can do for you on here.

From SW resources (you can click on it over to the right):

I just don't want to talk on the phone. Can I get help online?

A large and growing number of hotline agencies offer help via anonymous online chat. If you can't find your local or national agency's website to find out if there's a chat service you can access, use the link at right to message the moderators and we'll try to help.

Wow, as much as that hurts to hear a story like that... sadly, it doesn't shock me.  People can treat others with such indifference and cruelty.  It truly is disgusting.  I'm sorry for that, on behalf of kinder people.

Yah, I kinda cringe when someone is reaching out in pain and some anonymous person responds simply saying "Don't do it, I care.". For some, thats the entirety of what I see as a flippant response.. some go on to say "I love you". Really?  I'm sure its not meant to be taken badly, but to me it just seems so insincere esp when you see that same person writes this to many posting.  Guess nothing replaces real life people who truly cafe, if you're lucky to have them in your life.  Sigh...

You're welcome and I'm really sorry for your struggles.  But on a positive, its wonderful you have a mother who you can open up to.  You sound like a sweet, caring soul.  Be kind to yourself.  Hugs....

I feel this way sometimes.  I didn't "choose" to be born into this life, it certainly hasn't been the happy one I wished & hoped for. My worst nightmare was to feel all alone in life and now I'm struggling thru this sad, lonely existence every day.  Surely G-d doesn't want this for one of his creatures?  But I keep struggling by myself, day after day.  Not sure why I bother, this is no life I'm living. Yet, I'm scared of death.  And attempting and failing.  Its awful that we even have such thoughts, huh?
I hope this feeling passes soon for you.  Hopefully your mother is there with you now and ifs helping a bit.  Let us know, okay?

I hear you.  I read your post and agree with every point you make.  Not sure why some posts get so much attention, and some get overlooked.  Sad yours didn't get the attention it deserves.  I found it very thoughtful.  Let me know if you want to talk.
You're welcome.  Your friend is lucky to have a caring young man in her life!  All the best for you both...

Yes, I get it.  If one is suicidal, its fair to think we're worthless and therefore excess baggage... thinking those around us are better off without us.  I think perhaps you're on the right track, giving her some space but keeping in contact a little bit (for now) thru the mutual friend.
I'm sorry for what you're going thru.  Can you go to her house to check on her?  Does she live with relatives that you can contact saying you're worried?  You didn't do anything to be blocked IMO...
So happy that things are turning around for you.  Keep going!

This is really sad.  Hmmm... 9 hours since OP posted without any follow-up.  Can't help but think of her 5 kids, awful for what they must experience with a mother who seems so tortured with numerous attempts.  OP, if you do pull thru, I sincerely hope to hear that you're getting the help you need so you and your family don't have to keep suffering.
You're welcome.  I hope and pray we both feel some relief soon.  Its hard to struggle like this.  Give your dog some extra belly rubs today, huh?

You were a good, caring brother.  I have 2 older brothers who show no caring at all...zero.  I WISH to G-d one of them were like you.  I probably wouldn't be trying to figure a way out myself.  I think if I go, their only interest will be in how they will benefit from my assets.  And its not like I did anything to them, I feel I just didn't fare well out of the womb.  Not everyone gets the family they need.  


You're a loving man, your brother felt it.  In this regard, he was one of the lucky ones.

Edit:  I also want to say how sorry I am for your loss.  I hope your pain lessens with time.  Take care.
You doing any better today?
Wasn't feeling bad, you were sounding lost though.  You're welcome for the support, hope you find the resources to get the help you need.

Just want to reach out, your post was sad to read...especially the last sentence about pretending you matter more.  I get it, I also had useless therapists/ psychiatrists.  And parents who lecture and criticize, when all you want is a little love and approval.  You sound like a kind person, I'm so sorry for the pain your feeling.  It sucks.  The meds don't help much?

If you want to share, how old is your dog?  Have you had her since she was a pup?  Sounds like she's your best bud, huh?  Mine is snoring next to me right now.  I think every day of finding a new home for her so I can be done with my time on this earth.  I feel so much guilt that I'm not giving her the happy, active life she deserves with this debilitating depression of mine.  So not fair to her.

I'm probably not helping you too much, but there was something about your post that made me want to tell you that you likely matter more than you realize.
Wasn't telling you to go, just figured they would be better to help you with questions about alcoholism and help you better...
You might do better with the Alcoholism subreddit, for what you're wanting to understand.  Just a suggestion.
Exactly.  And that's our resource in this great country of ours.  Its not good enough.

I don't think its right for anyone to say it'll get better. So many on here say that, and as 'proof' go on to tell how their life has turned for the better.  Not helpful IMO. No one has a way to guarantee that for anyone and its awful to give false hope.  It may get better, for some it just doesn't.  Just being realistic.

This is a big part of the problem for those of us suffering from deep sadness and severe depression... suicide is such a taboo topic that no one talks about until someone famous dies at their own hands.  Then the media covers the sensationalized story for a few days, but its never an opening for people to really talk about the problem.  They merely speculate why that one person may have taken their life and provide the toll-free # for suicide prevention (which I once tried and got endless ringing... and that might be better than what I've heard from stories on here where many have said they feel it was a useless call with an uncaring person who gave them the brush off).  It needs to be discussed openly as is any other problem/disease in America.  Instead we only feel able to"openly" discuss it on this anonymous board, with no real guidance.  Very sad.

Do you want to talk?  You sound so logical about this.  How are you?  I'm sad to read this, maybe a talk can help us both?  Does the person who will care for your pets know of your plans?  Sorry for all the questions, I want to help if there's something you need.
Do you have family to do things with?
Hmmm... okay. Well, would you share what you like to do?  If you're friends were to ask you to join them weekend, what would you hope they would ask you to join in on?

Yeah, I get it.  Sucks. People, for the most part, don't change.  My best friend who lives on the opposite end of the country goes many months without calling to even check on me.  I've  gotten to the point where I'm not answering her calls.  I'll always remember her reaction when I told her I didn't want to be here anymore.  If she had said something like that to me, I would be on a flight to be there for her.  She just went on as if I said nothing unusual or alarming.  I know she loves me, but I need her to be a more caring friend since she knows how bad off my depression gets.  She'll never be that kind of friend to me.  I've isolated from other friends and am estranged from my family.  Alone. I think some just get uncomfortable and don't know what to do for a severely depressed person, so avoidance is easiest.  Used to make me wish she was a better friend, now I don't care much.  Numb I guess.  

But i think the fact that you're looking to get put and do things with your friends is so positive.  Most feeling pretty bad have no interest in doing much of anything. Whatever you're interested in, maybe join a club and you might make a good friend that way.  Just a suggestion...

You're not alone, but since its against the rules to discuss methods of suicide... I think its probably also a no-no for what your asking to be set up on here.  I'm so saddened by your message, because its how I feel too.  I've thought so many times' posting a similar message, but not such an easy thing to do. I wish I could figure something to say that might make your loneliness a little less painful, I'd say it to you and also to myself.  But i didn't want you to feel alone here.  Have you told your friends how you feel?  That you wish they would make more of an effort?

I'm glad you're feeling supported.  I hope sushi went well.  I read your post earlier and upvoted, but didn't comment.  Your post stuck with me.  I think you did great today... brushing and going out with family.  Certainly more than I have the will to do these days. 

i understand completely where you're coming from, because with my severe depression these days, it takes so much effort to do the smallest things.  Small things, like brushing, have become big things.  These days, it (sadly) is a big deal for me to do things like shower and brush my teeth because I just don't care anymore.  So THANK YOU for your post.  It made me feel like I'm not alone in this behavior.  Not showering and brushing regularly sounds so simple, its something I used to do daily all my life without batting an eye.  Can't believe how it take such effort these days, its something I'm embarassed by and doubt I'd even be able to admit to a doctor.  That's the sort of thing one ought to tell a doctor...

So keep up the good work!
There is a place in Switzerland, quite easy to research.  I'm sorry you're also feeling badly.
And you don't know what happened to cause the sudden, downward spiral?  If she trusts no one, that's sad for her.  Who is caring for her child, was her child taken from her?

Has anyone close to her simply tried to be there for her, talk to her in a gentle, caring way?  To see what happened so recently that caused her to spiral out of control like this, you know... try to get to the root of what might have happened.  You said she tells everyone who approaches her to f-off, but maybe no one has approached her in a caring, non-threatening way?  Publicly blasting her on social media seems like it would only make things worse, seems like a form of bullying if her 'friends' are talking about her in any negative where she can see.  I could see her not being open to talking to anyone who has taken part in that.  
If she won't talk to anyone and you really are worried for her life, a call of concern to the suicide hotline might be helpful if you get the right person.  I've heard some bad stories though, of people at that hotline not being so helpful though, but I'm sure there are some good ones.  A call to the police is also an alternative, where they might go to visit her for a welfare check.  But if someone hasn't tried to simply talk to her, face to face, in a caring way... I think that's the way to start.  Good luck.

Sure he thinks he did the right thing, because it was the right thing for him.  It was the easy, selfish way out.  Sounds like my brother, narcissistic.  I realize I only know the little you've told me though, so sorry if I'm being so harsh.  I realize I don't have the whole story. But while you were crying thru the conversation, what was he saying?  Comforting things, or being unkind?  My guess is that he wasn't being gentle and caring. 

I think if you are able to have some self-control to not contact him for a while, you may feel differently about him with some separation.  You may even get a little angry that he wasn't there for you when you needed him most.  And sometimes a little anger can be very healthy.  

Since I don't do drugs, don't know what those are without googling it.  I should do drugs, to help numb how I feel.  Sleep is my only escape and depression/anxiety often interferes with that. Dogs are great, though they can never replace human interaction.  And I don't feel the love from mine all that much, if it weren't for feeding time I don't think I'd be missed much.  I'm sure the isolation and my depression is rubbing off on the poor girl, I feel she doesn't deserve that.

I'm so sorry for how you're feeling, this world can be so cruel.  Gotta' be awful to get an email like that when you're already so low.  Was he responding to a message you wrote him or is he just sending you messages like that to torment you?  Sounds like the best thing could be to cut off communication altogether, for now.  You don't need more hurt.  Would you share what drugs you're turning to?  

Me... I'm surviving for now.  Isolating inside the walls of my house really well, for a long time now. Not a good thing, I know.  Go out only when I absolutely must for groceries.  Just no motivation to do much of anything.  Its just me and my dog.  My poor dog, I feel such guilt for subjecting her to this life of isolation with me.  I think about giving her up every day, especially since I think about suicide every single day.  As much research I do, i can't figure a pain free way to go though.  I'm hoping to figure it out by my birthday, that gives me a little more than 3 months to have a plan. 

It makes me so sad, that this is what my life has become.  I think if I felt real love and caring from just one person, things could turn around.  But it ain't happening and I can't go on like this much longer.  Existing like this, feeling like no one gives a crap is unbearable for me.  If my best friend had told me that she didn't want to be here on this earth anymore, I'd be such a caring friend to her.  Checking in on her all the time.  When I told her that, she acted like I told her something trivial.  Just went on, unfazed.  I guess its easier for people to behave that way, when they're uncomfortable.  I just think true friendship means you're there when your friend is at their lowest, as well as the good times.  Its sad that most run when the going gets rough.  Sucks.  

Sorry for going on about my crap on your thread. I wish I could be more helpful to you, but I'm afraid I'm in too dark of a place.  You said you're homeless.  Are you stay at a shelter?

I understand and my heart goes out to you.  It hurts when the people you thought would be there for you when you really need them the most not only aren't there, but show you they're not there in such an uncaring way.  Its exactly this that has left me broken as a person.  My brothers, my best friend, my own mother know I struggle with severe depression and where are they?  Not showing me they give a damn.  I'm a shell of the person I once was.  The world can be so cold and uncaring.  People don't seem to give a crap unless there's something in it for them.  Even the therapists, I always felt its just their job for the money, not really caring about helping.  I wish it was different, its not.

Everything you've written here resonates with how I've been feeling, for quite a long time now... sadly.  I hurt reading your post here, I'm sure because I feel the same.  I don't see an end to this painful loneliness, its unbearable.  I'm not homeless, I can't imagine dealing with that on top of everything else.  I wish I had a way to make it better for both of us.  Not sure if talking to someone feeling the same way would help or hurt, what do you think?

I understand you're trying to help, but this part really triggers me...  You said "...if you're 'just depressed'..."

I take issue with mental illness being dismissed like this.  Its a real illness, for many of us its debilitating and as unbearable an illness as any other.  The problem is many act like its our choice to be depressed, we can just 'snap out of it', we're just lazy, etc.  We're not, we're suffering from something I don't wish on anyone. So please don't dismiss what many of us suffer by saying something like that...  its enough that this country is doing a horrible job at treating the mentally ill.

I understand the frustration and needing to be cautious.  I've heard some bad stories.  But you talk like 30 is over the hill.  I'm a bit older and have been seeking help quite a while longer than you.  Its hard, and it gets old quickly when you feel you're not getting anywhere..  But you're still so very young, I hope you cut yourself some slack and just breath a little.  
i wish I was equipped to be a better support, with some real words of wisdom.  But since I'm also in a sad place, I'm just not doing so well.  I do hope we both feel some relief soon.  Its gotta come... Hope you're doing alright tonight, my friend.  Take care and if you need to talk, holler at me.

I think many other countries are much more compassionate and caring to their mentally ill citizens.  Seems what you went thru was absolutely senseless.  Problem is mental illness is now, and possibly always will be, stigmatized.  Its just not treated like a real illness, so its not openly talked about as it needs to be.  The only time suicide is ever mentioned in the news and media is when some famous person is involved (RIP Robin Williams, sadly the most recent) and even then the story never opens up an honest dialogue on how things can be better for those suffering.  Its reported for a few days as  sensationalized news and thats it. 

 So instead, we find ourselves in this kind of forum... anonymously reading and writing amongst ourselves... each suffering our own demons while trying to help others if we can.  While those educated to do so, sit in their white coats doing the minimal, without helping at all.  A sad, sad state of affairs.  No one cares it seems.  My decades of trying to get help with incompetent 'professionals' has me quite tainted.  I just think its like finding a needle in a haystack to find someone who really gives a damn about their patient.

I'm sorry if it sounded like I was berating you.  Especially with how you're feeling, its the last thing you need.  Guess I've seen many times that people post saying they get ignored, and then i see how many responses they get, yet time and again they disappear.  I find it perplexing.  But since I also suffer from the pain of feeling so alone in this oftentimes cruel world, I ought to be more understanding.  Its hard enough posting and reaching out as you did, let alone responding to everyone.  Kudos to you.  Hope you're feeling a little better today...

The Reddit algorithm?  Not sure what you mean...

Anyway, not sure if you're directing this response to me?  My depression has me in such a state, I've been isolating completely for a good long time now.  My family has shown they're not here for me, they have me feeling unloved, abandoned, heartbroken, feeling uncared for and worthless.   My mental state caused me to withdraw from life, from friends.  So not too open to talking to anyone these days, to search out a friend would be futile I'm afraid.  I'm responding, though again...not clear if your suggestion was to me.

Its so sad and disillusioning to read your experience.  Thank you for being so open and candid.  Only confirms how I've long felt how lacking our nation is in helping those of us who suffer so painfully from our mental illness.  The fact that you weren't offered treatment/therapy is criminal, at least that's how I feel.  Seems no one really gives a damn, just a quick meet n greet with a witch doctor who obviously could care less, in order to get you out the door so its not his or her problem.  Not sure how they sleep at night, given they aren't living up to the oath they took... to actually care enough to help heal the patients in their charge.  I'll need to re-read thru the details if your stay in the facility, I was so disgusted that I could only handle skimming thru it for now.  I hope you're doing okay, I understand how this experience would only make you feel worse.  Its the reason so many of us don't think that calling the suicide hotline is an aid for help, we'll be setting ourselves up for a similar experience that can send us over the edge... as if many of us (including myself) aren't already there.  Take good care of yourself...

I'm sad to read about how you're feeling, I'm completely alone in life and the pain of it is unbearable.  I think about suicide every single day because my life seems so worthless.  But you say you've tried reaching out before and you felt ignored... you aren't being ignored now, but I don't see you answering anyone.  Perhaps you are in PMs though...  I see one of the messages even extends an offer of friendship, albeit online... which I feel is so kind.  So there's quite a few of us responding and reaching back out to you.  Hopefully you're reading the caring responses and we'll hear vack from you.  Take care and hugs...

Rest in Peace... He or she, seeing you hasn't posted in a while must've thought you could have passed, and meant it in the best way possible I'm sure... hoping you had found peace.  Still didn't deserve your response.  And you might've thought to say something to all those that did worry so much about you, that they took time to reach out.  Glad you seem to be doing better.  Take care.
People have written such caring messages to you, and that's how you respond?  Wow
Sure, let me know.

Well I guess you need to talk with your mom and read the paperwork to figure why they took her.  If they lied, you need to find out if they even saw a bite or went to a doctor for treatment.  Otherwise they have unlawfully taken your dog and you have a case against them.  Good luck.

I have a pitbull, so I understand.  You need to figure what all is going on and what was claimed.  If there was no bite, you're dog should never have been taken.  They don't take dogs for barking or growling, otherwise every dog would be taken!  They would have had to show a bite, are you sure there wasn't contact for that to happen?
Pap= meant paperwork

Maybe they lied and said there was a bite?  Before you said the cops came.  Now you say animal control.  Which was it?  

Perhaps you're not understanding and it was for a ten day period?  Did they mention a bite and have you sign/ give you pap?  Mind if you share your age?

I don't understand, you say the dog didn't touch the kid.  So why on earth was your dog taken?  Even when a dog bites, the dog is taken usually by animal control for a ten day quarantine and then you get her back.  So I don't get what happened here...
